statement: The U003 confounder is real but mis-stated if framed only as a token-count issue: the decisive variable is context relevance. Evidence shows imprecise KG context can drop below the no-context baseline, subgraph scope trades recall against precision, and long contexts are used non-uniformly. Therefore a matched-token comparison alone is insufficient — the experiment needs an equal-length irrelevant/random-triples arm and a relevance-selection condition, otherwise a gain in the context arm cannot be attributed to passage relevance rather than to any extra context at all.
